title: VaultSolSigning
description: ADR-021: the two-phase Solana external-signer ceremony over the vaultd IPC. This top-level shape is the PHASE 1 request (sol_approve_facts): the operator-entered facts; the chain-labeled approval phrase is typed on vaultd's own terminal and NEVER travels this wire. The other messages are in $defs: sol_sign (phase 2 request — the adapter-built message + authoritative final fee; the private key is pasted on vaultd's terminal with echo off and NEVER travels this wire in either direction), sol_approve_response / sol_sign_response (the response carries only the public key and the signed artifact), and error. Approvals are single-use with a ~90s expiry (the blockhash lifetime bound); any phase-2 attempt consumes the approval, and a failed or expired ceremony re-runs in full (no silent re-sign). Scope: exactly one system-program transfer per message.

cluster_chain_id.description: internal registry ids (devnet / mainnet-beta) — reserved non-EVM band, valid ONLY on this same-user vault IPC, never on any browser-facing wire

from_pubkey.description: base58; the key pasted in phase 2 must derive to exactly this

fee_estimate_lamports.description: authoritative getFeeForMessage result for a provisional message, labeled as pre-approval estimate; null = unknown, which refuses on mainnet (unknown is not evidence, ADR-021 §4)

nonce.description: from sol_approve_response; single-use — consumed by this attempt regardless of outcome

message_hex.description: Message::serialize() bytes of the adapter-built message with a FRESH blockhash. vaultd independently re-decodes this and refuses any deviation from the approved facts (fee payer, single transfer, recipient, amount, num_required_signatures == 1)

final_fee_lamports.description: authoritative fee for THIS message; null refuses on mainnet; a value above the approved estimate refuses (FeeExceedsApproved)

pubkey.description: base58 pubkey the key derived to (== approved from_pubkey)

signature.description: base58 ed25519 transaction signature (the chain-native tx reference)

raw_hex.description: bincode-serialized signed transaction, ready to broadcast. NEVER key material.

code.description: Ceremony-level refusals (this schema's scope). VLT-SOL-001 cluster not permitted · VLT-SOL-002 approval phrase mismatch · VLT-SOL-003 invalid facts · VLT-SOL-004 fee refused (mainnet unknown, or final exceeds approved estimate) · VLT-SOL-005 no/expired/mismatched approval (full re-run required) · VLT-SOL-006 unsignable message (undecodable hex, malformed, non-transfer, multi-transfer, wrong signature count — an undecodable phase-2 attempt still consumes the approval, ADR-021 §6) · VLT-SOL-007 message deviates from approved facts · VLT-SOL-008 key refused (malformed, or derives to the wrong address; detail never echoes key input) · VLT-SOL-009 signer error · VLT-SOL-010 vault is locked (the operator lock gates both phases, checked before any terminal prompt; locking drops any pending approval — ADR-021 §6) · VLT-SUR-001 vaultd has no controlling terminal (fail closed — the ceremony requires a tty). Note: protocol-framing failures shared with every vaultd request (malformed_or_unsupported, size_cap_exceeded) use the vaultd transport error envelope, not this ceremony pattern.
